rationale: The late-day squeeze momentum has stalled at $93.39 and price is now breaking below the prior two 1-minute candle lows ($92.90 and $92.85), returning over two-thirds of the position's maximum favorable excursion. With only 7 minutes remaining before mandatory market liquidation and the broader market under severe pressure (SPY -3.50%), the asymmetric risk shifts toward a final-minutes unwind back toward VWAP ($91.95). Closing now locks in the remaining gain while the spread can still be worked passively before the closing auction volatility.
